column1: # Spelling normalisation used when comparing texts with Cantus Index.
# Both texts are normalised the same way, so a rule only has to make two
# spellings equal, not choose the right one. Each line is a Python regular
# expression and its replacement, separated by a tab. Rules apply in order, to
# lower-case text with accents removed. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# Add rules here as new spelling habits turn up.
